name: Command Aura's ally buff 537248 procs once it has a spell_proc row (#3716, partial)
contract: Original Command Aura 524600 effect 0 triggers the ally buff 537248 through
SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE and the nearby raid target. The original triggered buff uses the
Magic hit table and also triggers negative Exhaustion 573255, so native whole-spell positivity does not
bypass its hit roll on an ally. Fixture and assert spell hit on the Ranger without injecting the proc
aura. Effective spell_proc supplies flags 69972 and falls back to the original 100 percent chance;
aura_ascension_raid_damage_aura computes 35 percent of the source Ranger ranged attack power and
requires actual nonperiodic hostile damage before triggering 537249. The original helper uses the Ranged
damage class, separate from the ally white melee attacks that supply its proc events. Fixture both
physical hit tables and expertise on that ally; assert its native melee hit chance and ranged hit
rating, preserve the original six-second observation and native proc-count check, and require real melee
and helper damage. Original targeting, exhaustion filtering, probability, cooldowns and scaling remain
unchanged. This scenario proves the actual proc event and damaging helper, not its damage formula.

steps.label: SETUP: the ally received the Command Aura buff
CONTRACT: the revived 537248 proc fires on the ally's direct damage
